learning_objective: 🎯 [Kids will revise Naming Words and learn the difference between Common Nouns (General names) and Proper Nouns (Special names).]
warm_up_hook: 📖 Look at your bag, your teacher, and your city. They all have names! Today, we will learn about Nouns and find out why some names are extra special!

lesson_modules.teaching_content: A Naming Word is the name of a Person, Place, Animal, or Thing. In Class 2, we proudly call them NOUNS (संज्ञा). If you can name it, it's a Noun!
These are general names for any person, place, animal, or thing. They do NOT start with a capital letter (unless they start a sentence).
These are SPECIAL names given to a specific person, place, animal, or thing. Proper Nouns ALWAYS start with a Big Capital Letter!
Did you know? Names of days of the week and months of the year are also special names! So, they are Proper Nouns too.

practice_mcq_quiz.question: ❓ Which of these is a Proper Noun (Special Name)?
❓ 'The cat is sleeping.' What is the Common Noun in this sentence?

subjective_practice.question: ✍️ Pick the Proper Noun from this sentence: 'I live in Mumbai.'
subjective_practice.hint: Look for the word with the special Big Letter that names a city.

subjective_practice.question: ✍️ Write a Proper Noun (Special name) for the Common Noun 'teacher'.
subjective_practice.hint: What is the name of your favorite teacher?

subjective_practice.question: ✍️ Fill in the blank with a Common Noun: I am reading a _____.

activity_or_assignment.title: 🎨 Common vs Proper Chart
activity_or_assignment.instructions: Draw a line down the middle of a page. Write 'Common Nouns' on one side and 'Proper Nouns' on the other. Write 3 pairs! (Like: boy - Rahul, city - Patna)

chapter_summary: ⭐ Nouns are names of persons, places, animals, or things.
⭐ Common Nouns are general names (boy, city).
⭐ Proper Nouns are special names and always start with a Capital Letter (Rahul, Delhi, Monday).
